macros.name: defsavecmd
macros.doc: \defsavecmd will overwrite an existing command; both \newsavecmd and \renewsavecmd will not do so.

macros.name: globalcmd
macros.doc: The commands \defsavecmd, \newsavecmd and \renewsavecmd may be prefixed by \globalcmd and/or \protectedcmd to yield global or robust definitions, respectively.

macros.name: protectedcmd
macros.doc: The commands \defsavecmd, \newsavecmd and \renewsavecmd may be prefixed by \globalcmd and/or \protectedcmd to yield global or robust definitions, respectively.
